stories.title: Kawhi Leonard Trade Officially Complete — He's a Raptor Again

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
IT'S OFFICIAL. Kawhi Leonard is a Toronto Raptor again. 🏆

The trade is complete — Kawhi heads home to the city where he won it all in 2019.

Training camp starts Sept. 28. The North is back.

#Raptors #WeTheNorth #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
What the Raptors gave up to get Kawhi back:

• Brandon Ingram
• Gradey Dick
• 2031 UPF
• 2033 UPF
• 2027 first swap
• 2 second-round picks

Worth every pick if he stays healthy. #Raptors #NBA

article.headline: Kawhi Leonard Is Officially a Toronto Raptor Again — And the Trade Is Done

stories.title: James Harden Stays in Cleveland — Agrees to 3-Year, $97M Deal

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
James Harden declines $42.3M option and signs a 3-year, $97M deal to stay in Cleveland.

Career earnings: $511 MILLION.

He joins LeBron, KD & Curry as the only players to eclipse $500M in career earnings.

#Cavaliers #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
The Cavaliers keep their core intact.

Harden back on a 3-year deal. Cavs training camp heads to Spain next week.

This team isn't done building — they're chasing a ring. #Cavaliers #NBA

article.headline: James Harden Signs 3-Year, $97M Deal to Stay with Cavaliers — Career Earnings Hit $511M
